role: Committed CI floor file (43.5, non-integer so check_budget_monotonicity.sh skips it) read by scripts/check_coverage.sh:43. Unlike the other two coverage floors it is enforced on TEST_SCOPE=unit runs too (check_coverage.sh:134-139).
toplevel: Single line `43.5`. Read by scripts/check_coverage.sh line 43 (MIN_VIEWS_COVERAGE_FILE). Every .ci/*.txt with an integer value is also compared against a baseline commit by scripts/check_budget_monotonicity.sh (ceilings may only fall, min_* floors may only rise, unless a `budget-raise-ok: .ci/min_coverage_views.txt` commit trailer is present in the compared range). Changes are owned by @chrissharp80 per CODEOWNERS.

flags.text: .ci/min_coverage_views.txt holds 43.5, a non-integer; check_budget_monotonicity.sh read_int() rejects anything not ^[0-9]+$ and the loop `continue`s, so the views coverage floor is never compared and can be lowered with no budget-raise-ok trailer while the ratchet prints clean. Its header lists only three floors (min_coverage, min_coverage_logic, min_localization_coverage).
